events.speaker: NELL
events.text: Supper's on already, I was expecting somebody tonight. Sit and eat, and if the bell rings on its own partway through, that's just Bellhollow. It does that.

events.speaker: NELL
events.text: You didn't flinch, didn't reach for a gun, didn't ask me to explain myself. Most folks manage one of those. You'll do fine here.

events.speaker: NELL
events.text: I'll ride with you, though I'll want back through here on occasion. Somebody has to mind the bell, and I've never minded the company it keeps.

events.speaker: NELL
events.text: I've sat up nights with worse than you for company, and never minded a bit of it being heard. I don't mind you hearing it either.
